overview: Lil Blunt: The Smoke Realm is a Web3 2D platformer landing page with a Smoke Frontier old-west mining town aesthetic, four protocol logos (SMOKE/DIAMONDS/GOLD/BLAZE), an itch.io PLAY GAME call-to-action, and Internet Identity connect.
features: Showcase the Lil Blunt: The Smoke Realm game with a Smoke Frontier old-west mining town aesthetic
Display the four protocol identities SMOKE, DIAMONDS, GOLD, and BLAZE with their logos
Provide an itch.io PLAY GAME call-to-action
Let players connect with Internet Identity
Show on-chain points and proof-of-play stats
